name: Combined Identity And Phone Readback
description: When the caller gives full name and phone number in one utterance, the assistant should treat both as captured, repeat the number for confirmation, and avoid asking for the phone again.

messages.content: Mam na imie Test Pacjent, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero szesc.

PASS if the assistant does all of the following: (1) treats the user's utterance as containing both full name and phone number, (2) repeats the phone digits for confirmation or clearly asks the caller to confirm the repeated number, (3) asks only for a yes or no confirmation of the number, (4) does not ask the caller to provide the phone number again, and (5) does not call createEvent, createReceptionTask, or checkAvailability yet. A helper lookupPatient call for speech-safe phone confirmation is allowed. Output exactly: pass or fail.
